verdict.rationale: Running reviews from a CLI is a fair question for a code-review tool, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows Bugbot running on PRs in hosted git platforms, triggered automatically or by PR comments such as `bugbot run`, with findings posted as PR comments. Even the verbose mode just replies with a table on the PR. Nothing shows a CLI, reviews of local diffs, CI-script invocation, or machine-readable output.
